title: Ordinary inner horn cell maps are inner anodyne in discrete space-valued presheaves
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and inner horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the space-valued presheaves of [def-coef-segal-presheaf-localization]. Write $P(\Delta)=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$, where $\mathcal S$ is the infinity category of small spaces, and for a small simplicial set $K$ write $dK\in P(\Delta)$ for the presheaf whose value at $[k]$ is the discrete space $K_k$; this is functorial in $K$. Let $\mathcal A_\Delta$ be the smallest class of arrows of $P(\Delta)$ containing $d(\Lambda^a_b\hookrightarrow\Delta^a)$ for all $a\geq2$, $0<b<a$, and closed under pushouts, small transfinite compositions and retracts, all formed in the infinity category $P(\Delta)$. Let $u:K\to L$ be a map of small simplicial sets that is a retract, in the arrow category of simplicial sets, of a small transfinite composite, continuous at every nonzero limit stage, of pushouts of small coproducts (possibly empty) of inner horn inclusions $\Lambda^a_b\hookrightarrow\Delta^a$, $a\geq2$, $0<b<a$, where all these colimits are formed degreewise in sets. Then $du\in\mathcal A_\Delta$.
